## Overview

Correct the rejected-draft detectability claim in `docs/features/watermarking.md`,
as discussed in the existing [#56105 comment](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/issues/56105#issuecomment-6130247561).

## Claims

- Clarify that accepted drafts can weaken detectability and target-only Gumbel
  recovery strength depends on residual uncertainty.
- Explain that a peaked residual can weaken the signal and a residual supported
  on one token leaves no key-dependent token choice.

## Validation

Analytical example only: `p=(0.5, 0.3, 0.2)` and `q=(0.2, 0.5, 0.3)` yield
`max(p - q, 0)=(0.3, 0, 0)`, normalized to `(1, 0, 0)`. A keyed draw cannot
change the sole supported choice.

`git diff --check` passes. In Codex Cloud (Linux x86_64),
at `478fd3eaf4b6eafd98c6a3e85781e96ec3461c12`:

```bash
.venv/bin/pre-commit run --files docs/features/watermarking.md
```

Exit 0: six hooks passed, 28 were skipped because no files matched, and the
hooks left no diff.
Python/engine tests are **NOT_RUN**. The change is confined to one docs
paragraph and changes no sampling behavior. No model or detection result is claimed.

[Read the Docs build #35106506](https://app.readthedocs.org/projects/vllm/builds/35106506/)
stopped in `docs/pre_run_check.sh` after the
[pre-commit eligibility gate](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/actions/runs/38334969729/job/115092879009)
failed. The docs renderer is **NOT_RUN**; MkDocs never started.

## Details

Related #56105. [#58426](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/58426) edits
the same paragraph and removes the categorical recovery claim, but adds no
explanation of residual uncertainty. [#60738](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/60738)
edits the same sentence for Red-Green while retaining that claim. This change
adds the narrow clarification of residual uncertainty for target-only Gumbel
recovery under standard rejection sampling.

---

<summary> Pull Request Checklist </summary>

</details>
